name: jait.link
description: Render a clickable link in chat to where a Jait change happened, or a relevant Jait page the user requested. Optional navigation card for a relevant user-viewable result inside Jait. Ordinary Markdown links are clickable and preferred in replies; do not call this after unrelated code edits or internal task tracking. This only displays a link and does not navigate automatically or modify anything. Use a short descriptive label, e.g. View the updated team. Supported pages: Chat: /, Messenger: /messenger, Agents: /agents, Threads: /threads, Pull Requests: /pulls, Todo: /todo, Email: /emails, Calendar: /calendar, Memory: /memory, Jobs: /jobs, Network: /network, Settings: /settings. Specific chats support /chat?sessionId=<id>; threads support /threads?threadId=<id>. Searchable pages support q, e.g. /emails?q=from%3Aalice or /settings?q=providers. Use search to set q with automatic URL encoding, or put parameters directly in href. jait.catalog exposes each page's supported queryParameters, including settings tab and nested search fields. Do not invent unsupported detail routes.

href.description: Internal Jait path from jait.catalog, e.g. /agents, /jobs, /settings or /network. Use only supported query parameters.

search.description: Optional search bar text for a page supporting q (chat, email, settings, todo, messenger). Encoded automatically into href; an empty string clears the search. For other search bars use the page queryParameters from jait.catalog in href.

label.description: Short user-facing link text describing what changed, e.g. View the updated team.
